test.create_query: CREATE TABLE vec_none (id UInt64, vec Array(BFloat16) CODEC(NONE)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO vec_none SELECT number, arrayMap(i -> toBFloat16((toInt64(sipHash64(number, i) % 2001) - 1000) / 1000.), range(768)) FROM numbers_mt(300000) SETTINGS max_threads = 8, max_insert_threads = 8
test.query: SELECT id FROM vec_none ORDER BY L2Distance(vec, arrayMap(i -> toBFloat16(sin(i)), range(768))) LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(length(vec)), max(vec[1]) FROM vec_none FORMAT Null
